statisticsType=2 (stat2 files) = CATEGORICAL: None, D0..D4 are mutually exclusive and sum to ~100.
Values are percent of county LAND AREA (not population), 0-100 with 2 decimals.

Row order differs: area-percent files are sorted newest week first; DSCI files are sorted oldest week first. MapDate is YYYYMMDD integer; ValidStart/ValidEnd ISO dates (Tuesday-Monday week). StatisticFormatID echoes statisticsType.

The USDM is a blended expert-judgment product, not a physical measurement; category boundaries are drawn at coarse scale, so small counties (Los Alamos) can flip entirely between categories week to week.

Series start 2000-01-04: in the area-percent stat2 files the first week reads None=100 and DSCI=0 for the study counties, followed by a jump the next week; treat the first week as a series-start artifact.

catalogue.source: USDA FSIS Meat, Poultry and Egg Product Inspection (MPI) Directory + Establishment Demographic Data (MPI Directory Supplement) + Inactive MPI Directory
catalogue.publisher: USDA Food Safety and Inspection Service
catalogue.vintage: Weekly FSIS update generated 2026-09-14 (HTTP Last-Modified of source CSVs).
known_caveats: ACQUISITION: www.fsis.usda.gov returns HTTP 403 (Akamai bot protection) to curl even with browser User-Agent/headers, and to WebFetch. data.gov catalog entries only link back to the same blocked FSIS page (no mirror). Files were read inside an interactive browser session and only the NM rows were transferred to disk; full national files are NOT stored. To refresh, download the three CSVs manually in a browser and verify against source_file_sha256.

Only federally inspected (FSIS grant) establishments. NM state-inspected plants under the NM Livestock Board State Meat and Poultry Inspection Program (NMSA 25-2-22, launched 2024-07-01) and custom-exempt processors (NMAC 21.33.2) are NOT in this file. No public NMLB establishment list was found (nmlbonline.com/mpi has no list; NMSU guide says list available from the Board on request, [telephone withheld · PIERCE-02]).

establishment_number encodes grant types joined by '+': M=meat, P=poultry, V=voluntary (exotic species etc.), I=import house, G=egg products; suffix letters are FSIS-assigned. One physical plant can hold several grants in one row.
activities is a '; '-delimited list (e.g. 'Meat Processing; Meat Slaughter; Voluntary Slaughter - Meat'). Slaughter capacity for local livestock = rows with 'Meat Slaughter' or 'Poultry Slaughter'.
size uses FSIS HACCP size: Large (500+ employees), Small (10-499), Very Small (<10 employees or <$2.5M sales); 'N / A' for non-producing grants (e.g. export certification, cold storage).
dbas is '; '-delimited brand/DBA names. duns_number and phone often blank. street values carry a trailing space.

Demographic file: flags are 'Yes' or blank (blank = not indicated, not 'No'). processing_volume_category / slaughter_volume_category are numeric codes 1.0-5.0 (see FSIS demographic documentation PDF for ranges); listeria_alternative e.g. 'Alternative 2 Choice 2'. meat_exemption_custom_* flags mark custom-exempt activity at FSIS-granted plants only.
district/circuit are FSIS administrative codes (NM mostly district 40; San Juan and Colfax plants in district 15).
Inactive directory covers establishments inactive <=3 years; inactive_effective_date gives closure date; activities blank for inactive rows.
Directory is a current snapshot (replaced weekly); no history. Keep retrieved date with any derived analysis.

Type values are coded (ACQ Acequia 1,686; ACQT Acequia Tunnel 4; CMD Community Ditch 6; DIT Ditch 15,969; LAT Lateral 5,874; CAN Canal 1,089; DRN/INTD/CLD drains; WST wasteway; UNK 358) but some rows hold decoded or free-text values ('Culvert','River','Feeder','Pipe','Abandoned','Interior DRN',' ', null). LengthMiles / Shape__Length (meters, UTM) are computed in the native projection.

catalogue.vintage: SRAM: initial release July 2026 (CSV dated 2026-07-23); SNAP-authorized stores from STARS as of June 2025, LandScan USA 2020 population, 2020-24 ACS tract estimates, Census 2025 urban area definition, 2020 Census tracts. LRAM: released April 2021; 2019 large retailer list, 2010 Census population, 2010 Census tracts.
known_caveats: LRAM 2019 uses 2010 Census tracts and 2010 population; SRAM 2025 uses 2020 tracts. Tract IDs are NOT comparable without the Census 2010-2020 tract relationship file; do not join LRAM to 2020/2023 tract boundaries.

SRAM and LRAM measure different store universes: SRAM = all SNAP-authorized retailers (incl. convenience stores); LRAM = supermarkets/supercenters/large grocery stores. Low-access flags are therefore not a time series.

SRAM splits measures into three tables: General Tract Characteristics, Straight Line Distance (SD_SRAM_* prefix, Euclidean) and Driving Distance (DD_SRAM_* prefix, network). Each has its own Variable Lookup CSV.

Blank cells = data unavailable or not applicable (ReadMe); there are no -9999 style sentinels. LRAM has many blanks in NM (22,824 blank cells across NM rows) e.g. for 'share' variables in tracts without that population.

Flags (LILATracts_*, LATracts*, HUNVFlag, Urban, LowIncomeTracts, GroupQuartersFlag) are 0/1. LA thresholds: urban 1/2 or 1 mile, rural 10 or 20 miles; 'half' variables count people beyond 1/2 mile regardless of urban/rural.

Counts (lapop*, lalowi*, TractSNAP etc.) are modeled allocations of tract population to LandScan grid cells (SRAM) or 1/2-km grid (LRAM), not direct counts; *share variables are percents 0-100 in both SRAM and LRAM (observed min 0, max 100).
SRAM CensusTract20 in the General Tract Characteristics file drops the leading zero for states 01-09; read as string and zero-pad to 11.
County24 exists because Connecticut counties changed to planning regions in 2022; NM County20==County24.

ENCODING: the three SRAM 2025 data CSVs are NOT UTF-8 (cp1252/latin-1; e.g. 'Doña Ana County' byte 0xF1) - read with encoding='cp1252'. SRAM variable lookups are UTF-8 (General lookup has a BOM). LRAM 2019 CSVs are UTF-8.

catalogue.source: Wildfire Risk to Communities data download (states, counties, communities/places, tribal areas)
catalogue.publisher: USDA Forest Service (Wildfire Risk to Communities, v2 methods)
catalogue.vintage: Workbook 'last update 4/15/2026'; underlying WRC v2 modeling (2024 release) on Census geographies.
known_caveats: Only percentile RANKS (BP_STATE_RANK, BP_NATIONAL_RANK, RISK_STATE_RANK, RISK_NATIONAL_RANK, 0-1) and building exposure fractions are provided; raw burn probability (BP) and risk to potential structures (RPS) values are NOT in this workbook (raster/GIS downloads on the site are separate and were not fetched).
BUILDINGS_FRACTION_ME/IE/DE are labeled 'percentage' in METADATA but stored as fractions 0-1 (Minimal / Indirect / Direct exposure zones); they sum to 1.
State ranks are within-state percentiles; national ranks compare against all counties (or all communities). Tribal areas are ranked against tribal areas AND counties.
GEOID is stored as a number in Excel: leading zeros are lost for states with FIPS < 10 (not an issue for NM 35xxx, but read as text and zero-pad for national joins).
INSUFFICIENT_DATA='Yes' rows have unreliable/absent metrics (Communities and Tribal Areas only).
Buildings exclude pixels on water/ice and in protected areas (per METADATA footnote), so TOTAL_BUILDINGS is not a structure census.
Place boundaries do not cover unincorporated rural land; much of Mora, Rio Arriba, Taos population lives outside Census places.

catalogue.source: World Bank World Development Indicators
catalogue.vintage: retrieved 2026-10-05; the World Bank revises back-series without notice
known_caveats: The Euro area is an aggregate of changing membership; its back-series is not a constant set of countries.
Many series are compiled from national sources with differing definitions; cross-country levels are less comparable than within-country changes.
Coverage is uneven: Gini, R&D and patents have large gaps, and missing years are absent rather than zero.
Annual frequency cannot observe a quarter, so no business-cycle turning point can be dated from this source.
No vintage information is available, so this source cannot support a no-future-information historical reconstruction on its own.

catalogue_summary.the_problem: 43 of 62 holdings carry a MINIMAL manifest that does not state geographic coverage, suppression or resolution, and 3 carry none at all. A catalogue that cannot say what a holding covers is how a phase comes to believe something is not held.

census_cbp.verified_by: reading every row of the file and counting NAICS code lengths per county
excludes: most crop and animal production -- CBP's agriculture coverage is a few support establishments, not farms
census_cbp.suppression: small cells are withheld. A child NAICS absent from the file is UNPUBLISHED, not zero, and the published parent bounds what is hidden.
never_establishes: available capacity, utilisation, or willingness to serve

census_bps.unit: dwelling units AUTHORISED by building permit, annual, by county
census_bps.verified_by: reading every county row of every annual file and comparing the estimate columns against the reported-only columns
census_bps.caveat: a permit is an authorisation. Units permitted are not units started, completed, occupied or sold, and a permit may lapse. Census imputes for non-reporting permit offices; where the imputed column differs from the reported one, the difference is carried here per county-year.
census_bps.why_restricted: coverage was verified across 3076 counties by reading every annual file. The annual series is published here for the 7 places Dula covers, because the rest is weight the browser would carry for nothing.

fields_not_held: willingness to serve a new development
sdwis.verified_by: joining the geographic-area table to the system table on pwsid and tallying per county served
sdwis.caveat: one system may serve several counties, so county tallies are not additive to a regional total. A system flagged as a WHOLESALER sells to other systems, so its connections are not distinct retail connections and summing across a county that contains one double-counts.

nass_census_of_ag.verified_by: streaming the full release and filtering to New Mexico county rows
nass_census_of_ag.suppression: (D) withholds a cell that would disclose an operation. It is not zero.
nass_census_of_ag.caveat: a five-yearly census, not an annual series. Sales are GROSS RECEIPTS at the farm gate, not margin, and 'operations' counts places that sold or normally would have sold $1,000 of product -- most are not commercial farms.

entities.verified_by: counting nodes and relationships by geoid and node type
never_establishes: that the named party would participate in anything
entities.caveat: A RESEARCH INVENTORY, NOT A CENSUS. This population was built by the food study, so its shape is the study's reach and not the economy's structure. A sector absent from it is a sector the study did not look at.

construction_industries.name: Transportation structures and highways and streets

bea_io_detail.verified_by: opening the workbook and enumerating its industry columns and commodity rows
bea_io_detail.was_assumed_absent: R3.21 named the concrete share of construction's nonmetallic mineral purchasing a CRITICAL unknown and wrote that resolving it needed detail tables 'if the detail tables are acquired'. They were already in data/raw/bea_io, beside the summary table R3.21 read.
never_establishes: anything about New Mexico. Every cell is a national average.

HOUSING_CONSTRUCTION.label: Housing and construction
HOUSING_CONSTRUCTION.note: CBP sees the contractors. It does not see the units, which is what census_bps is for, and it does not see a project, which is what the MFA award lists are for.

WATER_WASTEWATER.label: Water and wastewater
WATER_WASTEWATER.note: MOSTLY INVISIBLE TO CBP. Public water utilities are government and CBP excludes government, so the sector's employment here is a fraction of the activity. SDWIS is the real holding and it reaches named systems.

FOOD_AGRICULTURE.label: Food and agriculture
FOOD_AGRICULTURE.note: CBP DOES NOT SEE FARMS. Crop and animal production is almost entirely outside CBP's scope, so agriculture must come from the Census of Agriculture or it does not come at all.

ENERGY_UTILITIES.label: Energy and utilities
ENERGY_UTILITIES.note: same government exclusion as water for publicly owned utilities

MANUFACTURING.label: Manufacturing
MANUFACTURING.note: the one system where CBP's detail is genuinely strong

TRANSPORT_LOGISTICS.label: Transportation and logistics
TRANSPORT_LOGISTICS.note: establishments are seen; routes, loads and freight cost are not

HEALTHCARE.label: Healthcare
HEALTHCARE.note: employment and payroll are strong; service capacity and unmet need are not in CBP

PROFESSIONAL_TECHNICAL.label: Professional and technical services
PROFESSIONAL_TECHNICAL.note: a sector where much of the activity is nonemployer and therefore outside CBP

RETAIL_CONSUMER.label: Retail and consumer services
RETAIL_CONSUMER.note: the largest employer in several of these counties and the least studied by Dula

the_position: 62 holdings, 1,235 files, 1.49 GB. County Business Patterns reaches six-digit industry detail in 7 of 11 Dula places and is absent for 4. Three times in three phases a holding was reported absent while present, and in every case the file was open in the same process that said it was missing. What was missing was not the data. It was any representation of what the data covers.
